PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH

Part-time Faculty (Law) 01 Rs. 22,800/- (fixed)
Walk in Interview for appointment of Part-time faculty to teach B.A.LL.B (Hons.), B.Com.
LL.B. (Hons.) and LL.M. classes, will be held on 15th February, 2023 at 11:00 a.m.
(Documents to be submitted by candidate from 10:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.) in University
Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh as per the following tentative
schedule:
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. Norms

All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
including publications (with photocopy of certificates) for verification along with the duly
filled form giving the details at the time of interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(http://jobs.puchd.ac.in.forms.php pages 1 to 9).
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching in the
University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Part-time Faculty.
